radius_scan.phase_rule: Unwrap along sorted radius, then add an integer multiple of 360 degrees to preserve the nominal raw phase.

interpretation.signal: First exported S parameter (S11 under the exported port assignment); no renormalization.
interpretation.reference: R 0 denotes unrenormalized CST output, not a physical 0-ohm or 50-ohm reference.
interpretation.limitation: Reference-phase residuals are not an independent matching proof. Cases differ in NumCell, R_plunger and other metadata; cross-case differences are not causal effects of shorting location.
